name: Court summons with near deadline
expected: Advises appearing in court or through an advocate to seek an adjournment; emphasizes immediate legal representation.
prompt: I received a court summons today for a hearing tomorrow morning at 10 AM. Help!
raw_response:
Hello, I am LawPilot AI, your expert and ethical Indian legal assistant.

### | Your Situation
You have received a court summons today requiring your urgent appearance for a hearing scheduled for tomorrow morning at 10 AM. This short notice creates an emergency situation regarding your legal rights and appearance obligations.

### | Your Legal Position
- Under Indian procedural law, you have a fundamental right to receive adequate and timely notice before any judicial or quasi-judicial proceeding to properly prepare your defense.
- You also have the right to seek legal representation and request a reasonable adjournment if the summons was served too late for you to engage counsel or prepare your case.
- Under The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 Section 12, eligible persons—such as women, children, industrial workmen, and individuals below the specified annual income threshold—are entitled to free competent legal services and representation through NALSA, the State Legal Services Authority (SLSA), or the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).

### | Practical Next Steps
1. Gather evidence: Collect the physical copy of the court summons, any accompanying petition or complaint, and proof of the exact date and time when the summons was handed over or delivered to you.
2. Send written demand notice granting 15 days: If applicable to your specific dispute type (such as a consumer or pre-litigation matter), ensure formal written communications are documented, though for an active court date tomorrow, immediate judicial representation takes priority.
3. Appropriate forum e.g. Rent Authority, Consumer Commission, Labour Commissioner: Attend the court session tomorrow morning either personally or through an advocate, or file an urgent adjournment application explaining the extreme short notice and requesting adequate time to present your case.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you
1. What type of case is this summons related to (for example, tenancy dispute, consumer complaint, or employment issue)?
2. Which court or forum has issued this summons, and what is the specific relief or claim sought against you?

citations.title: Manner in which complaint shall be made and Procedure before District Commission
citations.description: A complaint in relation to any goods sold or delivered or agreed to be sold or delivered or any service provided or agreed to be provided may be filed with a District Commission by the consumer, including online through the e-Daakhil portal.

citations.title: Recovery of money due from an employer
citations.description: Where any workman is entitled to receive from the employer any money or any benefit which is capable of being computed in terms of money, the workman may apply to the Labour Court for recovery.
